description: OpenLitterMap is a public-source platform for collecting, classifying and mapping geotagged litter observations. Its maintainers publish a PHP/Laravel backend and Vue frontend with MySQL, Redis and documented API routes. Inputs include photographs, locations and litter tags; outputs include mapped observations, location statistics and GeoJSON responses. Coverage is global but participation-dependent, and spatial detail follows user-supplied coordinates, not a systematic sampling grid. Source code is free under GPL-3.0, while the README separately assigns ODbL to data. A limitation is that hosted API functions have different authentication and verification rules: public map responses exclude private or unverified observations, and deployment needs several configured services. The platform can prepare litter-distribution evidence for waste-collection simulations, complementary to SwolfPy (model-swolfpy). The repository provides setup instructions and a detailed API reference. Provider usage counts were not independently audited, and no account, photograph or observation dataset was accessed. This record concerns the reusable collection and preparation platform.
